{{Otheruses|Unidentified Imperial Security Bureau agent}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] '''agent''' who was assigned to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]] [[Dandamont Pring]]'s [[Consul-General Pring's diplomatic estate|diplomatic estate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

He suspected that a [[Unidentified Imperial defector|member]] of Pring's staff, a minor bureaucrat, was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and had contacted [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[operative]]s. Indeed, the defector felt that he was being watched, and planned to make his move during Pring's opulent party to announce the engagement of his daughter, [[Praleena Pring|Praleena]].

Right when the traitor was ready to elope with Praleena, and share crucial [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] with the Rebels, the agent showed up with armed [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]]. However the Rebels (and the eloping lovers) found a window of opportunity and fought their way out.

The smug ISB agent failed in his task and complied with the consul-general's efforts to cover up the incident to hide his own incompetence.
